rationale.consistency: Idiomatic Go and Caddyfile parsing patterns with excellent use of the standard library slices and maps packages.
rationale.edge_cases: Perfectly handles invalid options, missing keys, type assertion failures, and nil options map.
rationale.scope: Tightly focused on fixing the directive order leakage without any unrelated changes.
rationale.readability: Clear custom types, helper functions, and excellent comments explaining the state encapsulation.
rationale.robustness: Immutable data structures (cloning slices and maps) elegantly prevent all race conditions and state leakage.
rationale.maintainability: Encapsulates the order resolution logic beautifully via directiveOrderOption and directiveOrderFrom.
